Markus — quick summary:
- Account: Cobalt Health (DEAL-5892)
- Outstanding: $128,500 (INV-202706-987), due 2027-05-30, now 19 days overdue
- AP will only pay if Redwood provides Brazil WHT/tax residency evidence; Cobalt’s bank requires this to apply withholding at source
- External has provided their WHT form (attached); they will not release funds until we return equivalent doc

Proposed options:
A) Provide standard tax residency confirmation (finance/legal to prepare) and accept net payment; Redwood books gross and processes a gross-up to offset WHT (we absorb or invoice separately)
B) Offer a 30-day payment extension /temporary credit hold, contingent on receiving completed WHT certificate within 10 business days and a signed mutual action plan (MAP). No service interruption during the hold.
C) Escalate to Cobalt CFO with exec outreach (offer partial credit or one-time waiver) — higher precedence but sets a precedent

Recommendation: Option B to protect the relationship and avoid revenue write-off while we get legal/finance the certificates. I’ve attached a proposed payment-schedule-COB-5892.xlsx that outlines timing and credit exposure if we go with B.

Would appreciate approval to proceed with an executive outreach and to authorize a 30-day accommodation capped at $130k exposure.

Thanks,
